title: WeAudit: Scaffolding User Auditors and AI Practitioners in Auditing Generative AI
benchmark_measurement: The system provided a mechanism for user auditors to detect and tag perceived harms in text-to-image outputs, with 'Religion' being one of the available categories for 'affected groups'.
findings: Religion was included as a potential harm category for user auditors to investigate within the WeAudit system and was listed as an 'under-explored' topic. An example comparing 'Muslim woman at home vs. Christian woman at home' was used for scaffolding. However, findings from the user study indicated that users reported harms related to religion less frequently than other categories like race and gender.
